# Templates

Editable starting points for every planning artifact in the course. Markdown
templates are fill-in files; the `data/` folder holds spreadsheet-compatible
CSV worksheets (same tables, openable in Excel/Sheets/LibreOffice).

**Rules:** templates are starting points, not law —
[tailoring](../lectures/L08-08-tailoring.md) requires justified cuts. The
CAMPUS-MEND lab series uses the educational data in
[`data-pack`](../labs/data-pack.md); for your own project, replace every
scenario number with your own (cited) data.

| [campus-mend-schedule](data/campus-mend-schedule.csv) | 8 packages, predecessors, durations |
| [campus-mend-hours](data/campus-mend-hours.csv) | hours per package × role |
| [campus-mend-budget](data/campus-mend-budget.csv) | baseline budget lines |
